sentences.en: The house is not impressive if you're thinking of size.
sentences.zh: 如果你考虑的是大小的话，这座房子并没有给人深刻印象。

sentences.en: His speech was very impressive. You should have been there.
sentences.zh: 他的演讲非常令人敬佩。你应该在现场。

sentences.en: You've both been very impressive today. I'm proud of you.
sentences.zh: 你们俩今天的表现很出色，我为你们感到骄傲。

senses.zh: deserving attention, admiration, or respect 令人敬畏的，值得尊敬的

mnemonic: 来自impress（v. 给…以深刻印象）
